effective_rule: registered only by a merge to main of this file with status 'registered' and a launch decision written by the job; PS1 v3 continues unchanged and is not a control that this successor may modify
question: Does a no-trade band on the sizing weight reduce B2's turnover cost enough that B2 sizing beats VOL sizing in after-cost risk-adjusted return under STRESSED costs?
motivation: discovery data, not evidence: PS1 v3 through 2026-10-19T16:22Z (92 closed intervals, 400 h, 2 complete blocks) - ordinary net B2 -0.93%, VOL -1.50%, FIXED -1.07%; stressed B2 -1.56%, VOL -1.55%, FIXED -1.10%; B2 ordinary costs 808.40 vs VOL 66.21 (12.2x), annualized turnover 156.4 vs 13.3
primary: Sharpe(B2, band 0.05, every 1) - Sharpe(VOL, band 0.05, every 1), duration-weighted annualized log-return Sharpe, STRESSED costs (ps1-costs-1 stressed: 10 bp fee + 10 bp slippage + full spread)
secondary: every other candidate pair, reported with the family count (11 secondary comparisons) and never promoted on its own
conventions: identical to PS1 v3 by construction: the runner calls desk/paper_ps1.py rebalance(), sharpe_dw() and its verified ledger; decisions, captured-book fills, missing-data joint rule (only executions PS1 counted, all arms together), time accounting between fill times, capital and marking unchanged
uncertainty: moving-block bootstrap as PS1 (blocks of 42 intervals, 5,000 resamples, seed 20261019); no interval below 10 complete blocks

checkpoints.C1: 180 days after launch and >= 10 blocks: descriptive
checkpoints.C2: 365 days and >= 20 blocks: status vocabulary of PS1

claims_boundary: sizing and turnover on one synthetic spot policy; no direction, no live fills, no capacity
module: research_tools/ps1_t1_runner.py ps1-t1-runner-1.0.0 (research_tools/turnover.py turnover-1.0.0 is superseded for this purpose)
revision_note: Oct 19 2026 (repo 2.30, still PREPARED): (1) PS1 v3's own rebalance band is 0.05 (desk/research/ps1/protocol.json policy.rebalance_band), not 0.0 - revision 1 called band 0.0 'PS1's every-decision rebalance'; band 0.0 is a tighter control than PS1, band 0.05 IS PS1. (2) The executable runner is research_tools/ps1_t1_runner.py, which replays PS1's verified ledger with PS1's own rebalance() and accounting and refuses to report unless band 0.05 / every 1 reproduces PS1's recorded rows exactly (verified: 94 executions, 0 mismatches, Oct 19 2026); turnover-1.0.0's target-weight arithmetic does not preserve PS1's conventions and is not the successor's method. (3) Full identities replace abbreviated hashes. Revision 1 is in git history.
design_issue: the primary pair (band 0.05, every 1) is PS1 v3's own configuration, so as written the successor's primary comparison adds no new arm and repeats PS1's stressed-cost comparison; an operator decision on the primary band (declared before registration) is required. The discovery replay below was viewed by the implementer: a band chosen after it is a post-hoc choice and must be disclosed as such.
